name: zt-econ-digest
description: Digest a Chinese-translated economics book into ZET Cards: the ZT digest base with the economics set: the model layer (Model Cards in the digest, the model compiler with the economic architect), the event layer (Event Cards from the book's dated sentences), the empirical-results layer (Finding Cards, one per result), and the economics prompts; it builds only the Literature tree (Topic trees, hubs and the register are zt-idea-grow's)
whenToUse: Turn a Scholar Archive economics book (Chinese bilingual Markdown, digested as Chinese only) into an agent Literature tree with Idea, Event, Finding, and Model Cards (economic models at concept or formal level). It writes no Topic tree, no Hub Card and no register: zt-idea-grow grows those from the Literature trees afterwards. Modes link, models, cards, explain, events, findings, figures, audit and bridge re-run single stages on an existing digest.

preflight.P1: Goal and result: the book digest of the removed zt-book-digest.js for economics books, on the framework, with the economics layers as its own module set. The result is the base result with the model reports, events: {...}, and findings: {...}. The base 2.1.2 adds the Bridge report and isolated apply mode.
preflight.P2: Inputs: the base args plus events and findings (false skips that layer). Base Bridge arguments are inherited; base 2.4.0 adds args.book, the Scholar Archive Work id or title that resolves the book.
preflight.P3: Units of work: as the base, plus the Model Cards of the book (model layer), the dated sentences per group (event layer), and the sentences that report data with a number per group (empirical-results layer; 3 groups per DeepSeek job each).
preflight.P4: Roles: as the base (manager Haiku low, architect Sonnet, organizer Opus).
preflight.P5: Stage graph: args → source → prepare → [after-prepare] → terms → digest → cards → [after-digest: models] → [after-models: explain] → cards-book → link-prepare → link → link-check → [after-link] → organize → figures → bridge → audit → finalize → cleanup → report. 6.0.0 (base 5.0.0, docs/literature-only-digest-design.md): the digest builds only the book's Literature tree; the concept review, the restatement review, the hubs and the register plan left the run, and zt-idea-grow composes the Topic trees, the hubs and the register later. The Event and Finding layers fill after-terms, so they are worked from ledger readiness while the remaining digest groups run, and they file each Event and Finding Card beside the Literature Idea Cards it supports; after-digest: the model layer, released when the digest managers settle; after-models: explanations of the finished Derivation parts, which settle before the link pass; the whole-book card cycle waits for the Model reviews; then Figures → Bridge (Literature trees only) and the final audit. Bridge profile book. A resume and the repair modes drain the tail that their own layer released: modes models, explain, events and findings run their layer, the changed-Card Link pass and check, Organize, the audit and the settlement, and mode resume adds the finalization (#87, R283/R286).
preflight.P6: Modules (the economics set): the profile (dsh-digest-base.zh.md plus dsh-model-cards.zh.md: the digest writes Idea Cards and Model Cards; shared-prefix.md, link-prefix.md; the economic architect model-architect.md), zt-model-layer and zt-explain (zt-model-lib), zt-event-layer (event-compiler.ps1, dsh-event-instructions.zh.md), zt-finding-layer (finding-compiler.ps1, dsh-finding-instructions.zh.md; the Card type finding of zt 0.20.0). zt-bridge v3. 6.4.0: on base 5.4.0 (docs/workflow-simplicity-proposal.md steps 1-3 and S10: one relay type, the shared Lock reader, the frozen official DeepSeek source, the ledger as the one fault classifier, the dead code and unused args removed, plan-status and the notes count read from files). 6.4.1: on base 5.4.1 (zt-bridge v9: the Bridge stage applies its new-carrier proposals itself). 6.5.4: on base 5.5.4 (S24, #167: the Term-card branch `term-cards` beside the digest writers after `terms`, and the deterministic Term-link pass `term-link` after `bridge` and `term-cards`; their `termcards/*` and `termlink/*` ledger units, the frozen `termCards`, `termLink`, `termCardsPerJob`, `termCardsMathPerJob` and `termLinkOccurrences` args, and both stages in mode resume). 6.5.6: on base 5.5.6 (S26, #169: the finite finalization relinks the Cards its one correction cycle changed, or the whole book when that correction changed the Term mapping, through the shared `zt-term-link-lib`; the audit publishes each book's Term coverage, uses, T faults, no-use observations, avoid words and top terms, with the run generation and the check contract). 6.6.0 (S28, #170): the release build on base 5.6.0. No stage, data-flow, param or role change: it is installed with math 5.6.0 as one compatible set and carries the S26 finalization and audit with the S28 release manifest.
preflight.P7: Checks: as the base; each event and finding job runs its SELF-CHECK (precheck: fields, supported Cards, and zt-check on the drafts: E1, E2 or F1 to F3, and the Card language); apply refuses what the precheck reports; in mode full the link check card cycle then checks every Card of the book. Bridge BR1–BR9, exact report acceptance and guarded edits.
preflight.P8: Failure policy: as the base; the model layer halts only in mode models; the event and finding layers report refused items and go on. Modes: the base modes plus models, explain, events, findings. Bridge failure is nonfatal in full; bridge apply runs only args, Bridge and report. Mode resume accepts only out and spends the one supported resume; the repair modes keep their own layers and drain their dependent outputs instead of rebuilding unrelated groups or models (#87, R286). S30 pilot (#172), base 5.6.1 / econ 6.6.1 / math 5.6.1: a Term-card job that fails its writer or stays not ready after its one fix fails only its own unit and the remaining waves are still admitted (zt-term-cards v3); when the book unit cannot be claimed, the ready contiguous prefix is published without the book claim and the book unit stays incomplete; the whole-book Term-link pass, when its unit is blocked, links the published prefix without a claim and its unit stays incomplete (zt-term-link-lib v2, R0343 kept); mode resume reads the prepared run's own termCards/termLink switches (`ledger status -Summary` run_options, zt-digest-prepare v15) instead of the args defaults; the Term-card evidence and settle records are run-level (no -Unit run). 5.6.2 (#172): the Term stages run only Haiku managers and DeepSeek jobs: every deterministic step is one term-steps.ps1 call run by a DeepSeek drive job (zt-term-cards v4, zt-term-link v3); no relay agent. 6.6.3 (#175): the Event and Finding layers apply, report and record their block in the one finish step; a step that fails stops the stage with its reason, and per-unit outcomes stay ledger data. 6.6.4 (#176): the Cards-book, Organize, Figure, Bridge, audit, finalization and settlement stages run only book-steps.ps1 steps under Haiku DeepSeek managers (the one cleanup settle call included); the Organize decision stays with Opus. 6.6.5 (#177): the model layer runs only model-steps.ps1 steps under Haiku DeepSeek managers and its Sonnet architect stays; no relay agent remains in the economics digest, and the model layer stops with a failed step's reason. 6.6.6 (#178): on base 5.6.6, whose mathematics stages run only math-steps.ps1 steps under Haiku DeepSeek managers; no stage of the economics digest changes.
preflight.P9: Dry run: zt-econ-digest.sim.json. Fixture: tests/framework-harness.mjs checks the readiness graph, the ledger commands of the group cycle and every layer, the runner restrictions and the joins on the built script; tests/event-compiler.tests.ps1 and tests/finding-compiler.tests.ps1 use scratch archives. Run with zt 0.20.0 deployed. Pilot: one chapter after a database backup. 4.4.1: rebuilt with the DeepSeek Subagent Managed Protocol v1.1 block (2026-10-18: managers start runs with wait_seconds 0, poll all open sessions, collect and delete at once, block on one session for at most pollSeconds, cancel after budgetMinutes); no stage, data-flow, param or role change. 5.11.0: built on the base 4.11.0 Tree Lock seam (zt-digest-lib v31, zt-digest-prepare v10), so preparation and every writing stage stop with the archive's typed `card_locked` refusal and keep their drafts and receipts (#140). 6.0.1 (base 5.0.1, zt-digest-lib v32): every approval rule that lets a DeepSeek job run the zt helper refuses a helper command with -Open, which would leave the Literature scope; no stage, data-flow, param or role change. 6.1.0: base 5.1.0 (the report names the zt-idea-grow follow-up; the hub leftovers are gone). 6.2.0: base 5.2.0 (a block's checked finishes in one command, the Cards claim and finish in one command, one model-deps command per batch, the close round writes the batch report; docs/digest-claude-token-proposal.md); zt-event-layer v4 and zt-finding-layer v4 end their chains with the batch finish. 6.2.1: base 5.2.1 (zt-organize v7: the Organize decision reads run the helper with -Allow on the survey's empty read-only list, so they are reads only and carry a staging path; on the token pilot, run on a box copy, a path-less helper read reached the live box). 6.3.0: base 5.3.0 (zt-digest-lib v36, zt-math-lib v3; docs/digest-claude-token-proposal.md P5): a one-command relay runs as the new relay role, the zt-relay agent type (.claude/agents/zt-relay.md: PowerShell only, a short prompt), whose first request carries about 9k tokens of context instead of about 59k; the task text, schema, model and result handling are unchanged.

events.description: mode full: false skips the event layer

findings.description: mode full: false skips the empirical-results layer

after-terms.title: Events
after-terms.detail: the event layer: event-compiler.ps1 lists the dated sentences and each group's Idea Cards; DeepSeek writes the Event Cards as JSON with its SELF-CHECK; the script creates them beside the Idea Cards they support and links them

after-terms.title: Findings
after-terms.detail: the empirical-results layer: finding-compiler.ps1 lists the sentences that report data with a number and each group's Idea Cards; DeepSeek writes one Finding Card per result as JSON with its SELF-CHECK (F1 to F3); the script creates them beside the group anchors and links them with 印证

after-digest.title: Models
after-digest.detail: the model layer: the model compiler on every Model Card of the book (DeepSeek brief → Sonnet plan → DeepSeek fill, derive, review, split)

after-models.title: Models
after-models.detail: mode explain: 思路, 说明, and 解读 for finished Derivation parts
